summary: This plugin integrates Univer office capabilities into DeepSeek Harness so an agent can create, edit, import, and export spreadsheets, documents, presentations, and related content from natural language requests with in-conversation preview and review.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin’s primary function is to provide an in-app office content workflow for DeepSeek Harness users: creating, editing, importing, and exporting spreadsheet, document, presentation, and related content, then reviewing changes in conversation. It is exposed through dedicated Univer tools and worktree-based task execution with merge/discard controls, so its user-facing purpose is office document processing via automation rather than general development tooling.
